name: current_user
description: Profile of the WakaTime account that owns your OAuth token. Requires your own WakaTime personal OAuth token as _apiKey.

_apiKey.description: Your WakaTime personal OAuth access token (Bearer). Required for account data (current user, summaries, durations, heartbeats, goals, projects, commits); optional for public profiles and stats.

name: user
description: Public WakaTime profile for a user_id/username; keyless for public profiles, pass your OAuth token as _apiKey for your own or private ones.

_apiKey.description: Your WakaTime personal OAuth access token (Bearer). Required for account data (current user, summaries, durations, heartbeats, goals, projects, commits); optional for public profiles and stats.

name: summaries
description: Fetch WakaTime daily coding summaries for a user over a date range (start/end required, YYYY-MM-DD); returns per-day breakdowns by project, language, editor, OS, and category in seconds. Requires your own WakaTime personal OAuth token as _apiKey.

_apiKey.description: Your WakaTime personal OAuth access token (Bearer). Required for account data (current user, summaries, durations, heartbeats, goals, projects, commits); optional for public profiles and stats.

name: stats
description: Fetch aggregated WakaTime coding stats for a user over a range ("last_7_days", "last_30_days", "last_6_months", "last_year", "all_time"); returns totals and rankings by language, project, editor, and OS. Keyless for public profiles; pass your OAuth token as _apiKey for private ones.

_apiKey.description: Your WakaTime personal OAuth access token (Bearer). Required for account data (current user, summaries, durations, heartbeats, goals, projects, commits); optional for public profiles and stats.

name: durations
description: Fetch WakaTime coding durations (start/end timestamps with project and file) for a single day (date required, YYYY-MM-DD); optionally slice_by entity/language/branch for granular session data. Requires your own WakaTime personal OAuth token as _apiKey.

_apiKey.description: Your WakaTime personal OAuth access token (Bearer). Required for account data (current user, summaries, durations, heartbeats, goals, projects, commits); optional for public profiles and stats.

name: heartbeats
description: Raw heartbeats for a date. Requires your own WakaTime personal OAuth token as _apiKey.

_apiKey.description: Your WakaTime personal OAuth access token (Bearer). Required for account data (current user, summaries, durations, heartbeats, goals, projects, commits); optional for public profiles and stats.

name: goals
description: User's goals. Requires your own WakaTime personal OAuth token as _apiKey.

_apiKey.description: Your WakaTime personal OAuth access token (Bearer). Required for account data (current user, summaries, durations, heartbeats, goals, projects, commits); optional for public profiles and stats.

name: projects
description: User's projects. Requires your own WakaTime personal OAuth token as _apiKey.

_apiKey.description: Your WakaTime personal OAuth access token (Bearer). Required for account data (current user, summaries, durations, heartbeats, goals, projects, commits); optional for public profiles and stats.

name: leaders
description: Fetch WakaTime's public coding leaderboard; optionally filter by language or country_code and paginate; returns ranked users with display names and weekly coding totals.

name: commits
description: List the commits WakaTime has recorded for one project belonging to a WakaTime user, given user_id (or "current") and the project name, with optional author, branch, and page. Returns each commit hash, message, author, branch, timestamps, and the coding time WakaTime attributes to it. Answers what has been committed to a project tracked by WakaTime and how much editor time went into it. Requires your own WakaTime personal OAuth token as _apiKey.

_apiKey.description: Your WakaTime personal OAuth access token (Bearer). Required for account data (current user, summaries, durations, heartbeats, goals, projects, commits); optional for public profiles and stats.

name: editors
description: Fetch WakaTime's public editor usage statistics showing relative popularity of code editors and IDEs across all WakaTime users.

name: meta
description: Fetch WakaTime API metadata including current server time and available timezones; useful for validating timezone strings before passing them to summaries or durations.
